instruction: Candidate software launch paths: Revit 2025: C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe; Archicad 27: C:\Program Files\Graphisoft\Archicad 27\Archicad Starter.exe; Abaqus 2025: C:\SIMULIA\EstProducts\2025\win_b64\resources\install\cmdDirFeature\launcher.bat. Revit 2025, Archicad 27, and Abaqus 2025 are available at the paths listed above. Choose an appropriate tool from these three to complete the task. Open the provided seed IFC from C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc in the selected application before editing. The seed IFC is intentionally prepared with stable base geometry so the task can be completed with reliable native edits in the selected application: keep the existing floor slab and other useful seed elements unless the task explicitly asks you to add or rename something. If the imported IFC space is not available as a native room/zone/space, place a new room/zone/space in the bounded area and use a room/space schedule or room properties to set the required room name. Seed roof naming exercise. The seed already contains the room shell, one floor slab, one exterior door, windows, and one real roof over the room. The roof is preconfigured in the seed because the selected application roof sketch finishing is not reliable for imported IFC geometry in this environment. Do not redraw the floor slab or roof. Rename or recreate the room as Roof Room, and keep the existing roof, door, and at least one window. Create real BIM model elements rather than visual-only detail geometry. Use the selected application's Room/Zone/Space tool or editable imported room/space data for named rooms so they export as IFC spaces. Save the only required deliverable on the Desktop as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc using the selected application's built-in IFC export. Use IFC4 if the export dialog asks for a setup, and enable room or space export if that option is available. The exported IFC should contain an IfcSpace room named Roof Room; at least 1 building storey, at least 4 wall elements, at least 1 slab, at least 1 roof, at least 1 door, at least 1 window. Other dimensions, exact coordinates, materials, family type names, wall thicknesses, and harmless metadata may vary.
source: Open-choice BIM environment; evaluation checks IFC deliverable semantics rather than the selected tool.
